title: System Assurance And Runtime Hardening Roadmap
goal: Close the verified release-assurance, endpoint-resilience, local background-state and LLM budget/cache defects without reopening stale findings, duplicating Temporal, weakening privacy boundaries or enabling multi-worker and live release behavior without their own evidence gates.

queue_scope.explicit_named_execution: An explicit /abc SAR request may use this roadmap after a fresh claim and dependency preflight; a generic Open Work run must ignore SAR until canonical registration is complete.
queue_scope.registration_blocker: The canonical Open Work and human Post-MVP master files contain uncommitted work from another completed thread. This authoring slice must not alter or normalize those files.

required_registration_after_handoff.abc_execution_queue_rule: Register no implementation slice automatically. Expose only the dependency-safe frontier after the user explicitly starts SAR or Open Work selects the registered lane.

skills.purpose: Own queue resolution, claims, gates, evidence and integration.

finding_dispositions.finding: CI/CD is completely absent.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep the existing workflows, make regression tests blocking for PR, dev and main, and prohibit image publication without a same-commit successful quality gate.

finding_dispositions.finding: Release readiness reports static documented PASS baselines.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep the snapshot side-effect free and replace automated PASS with validated, commit-bound, non-stale evidence receipts that fail closed.

finding_dispositions.finding: The response cache evicts in insertion order instead of access order.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Use a capacity-exact, thread-safe LRU with bounded TTL and content-free metrics.

finding_dispositions.finding: Dead-host cooldown state is not persisted.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep the twenty-second health cooldown process-local so restart re-probes provider health; collect only content-free health metrics if later required.

finding_dispositions.finding: Positive and negative Tailscale resolution results never expire.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Use monotonic positive and negative TTLs, concurrency protection and explicit invalidation without real-network tests.

finding_dispositions.finding: The shared HTTP client disables HTTP/2.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep HTTP/2 disabled until the declared benchmark threshold and compatibility checks pass.

finding_dispositions.finding: The Agent loop opens a database session for every tool call.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Do not cache policy state unless a 1000-start benchmark crosses the declared latency threshold and invalidation remains synchronous.

finding_dispositions.finding: The authentication rate limiter is process-local.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Enforce one supported web worker and block multi-worker activation until shared rate limiting and logging are separately designed and tested.

finding_dispositions.finding: The context hard maximum is 32000 tokens.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep 32000 as the automatic default; retain explicit model, provider and operator overrides capped by the real context window.

finding_dispositions.finding: Token estimation ignores model_hint and uses one character ratio.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Route model_hint through deterministic tokenizer adapters and every productive hardlimit callsite while retaining a conservative offline fallback and the exact model-neutral legacy allowlist.

finding_dispositions.finding: RAGManager retries three import paths under broad ImportError handling.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Use only src.rag_vector and propagate internal dependency ImportError without path retries.

finding_dispositions.finding: The orchestration runtime loop does not execute durable work.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Temporal Event History, Activities, heartbeats, signals and retries remain the only durable 12-24 hour execution path; SAR must not create another scheduler.

finding_dispositions.finding: The Universal Inbox pipeline is an offline envelope.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep the canonical envelope and analysis worker pure; retain separately gated Nextcloud, Memory and Telegram effect executors.

finding_dispositions.finding: The old roadmap still reports provider proof as open.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Mark the old entry superseded by the later redacted provider evidence without treating historical evidence as permanently fresh.

finding_dispositions.finding: Dedicated Source View provenance drilldown remains open.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: USI and Lens own source metadata, locator, lineage, redaction and UI drilldown; SAR must not create an Obsidian-specific second source truth.

finding_dispositions.finding: The old roadmap still reports Nextcloud as unavailable.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Link the later bounded live-copy evidence and keep only the distinct Source View/provider-field UI work open.

finding_dispositions.finding: Fresh install and upgrade evidence does not clearly prove an external target.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Release-grade proof requires an isolated Debian or Ubuntu target distinct from the development checkout, exact candidate identity, backup, rollback and remote readback.

finding_dispositions.finding: Background jobs use unlocked file-based read-modify-write state.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Serialize every same-process mutation and follow-up claim while retaining the one-web-worker constraint and excluding Temporal work.

finding_dispositions.finding: RotatingFileHandler is not multi-process safe.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep file rotation only in the supported one-worker topology; a future multi-worker design requires one queue/listener or external collector.

finding_dispositions.finding: Telegram voice has no runtime integration.
finding_dispositions.required_outcome: Keep the core fakeable and offline while transport download, STT, Agent turn and gated reply remain injected by polling and webhook adapters.

frozen_decisions: Gate Evidence Core remains the sole canonical gate and evidence vocabulary. SAR may add a release receipt and adapter but not a second status model.
Release readiness remains a side-effect-free presentation layer. Tests, Git, providers and host commands run only in bounded producers outside the snapshot.
One Odysseus web worker is the supported topology. Long duration means durable Temporal workflows, not multiple web processes.
Background shell jobs remain local compatibility work with a maximum one-hour runtime. They never own Agent operation history, heartbeat, retry, claim, fence or resume state.
Temporal Light and HWA exclusively own deterministic 12-24 hour execution semantics.
Dead-host cooldown remains process-local and the automatic context hard maximum remains 32000.
Universal Inbox and Telegram voice core contracts remain pure; injected runtime adapters own all I/O.
Source View remains a USI and Lens responsibility.
No HTTP/2, Agent policy cache, multi-worker, external release or external-host action is authorized by this roadmap.
No receipt, benchmark, fixture, metric or handoff may contain secrets, private content, raw provider output, chat IDs or private host paths.

release_flow: A reusable same-commit CI quality gate runs blocking syntax and regression checks.
Only a successful quality gate may create a canonical redacted release evidence receipt.
The pure release snapshot consumes a validated receipt and maps it through the existing Gate Evidence Core.
Missing, stale, mismatched or incomplete receipt data produces pending or blocked, never PASS.
Manual provider, external install, upgrade, deploy, tag and distribution actions remain independent gates.
runtime_flow: Endpoint resolution uses bounded process-local cache entries and deterministic invalidation.
The web process remains single-worker while its rate limiter, log rotation and background file state are local.
Same-process background job mutations use one transaction lock and stable follow-up idempotency identity.
Temporal owns durable Agent operations; bg_jobs and bg_monitor cannot continue them.
llm_flow: model_hint selects an exact or calibrated tokenizer adapter when available.
A deterministic conservative estimator remains available without downloads or network access.
Response caching is process-local, capacity-exact, TTL-bounded and content-free in its metrics.
Transport and Agent-start optimizations require threshold evidence before implementation.

external_dependencies.requirement: Reuse CanonicalGate, EvidenceItem, redaction assertions and safe-now aggregation.
SAR-05 must hand off its authority boundary before TLR Activity and heartbeat integration; SAR does not edit Temporal runtime paths.
Required before generic Open Work execution, not before this named roadmap contract can be reviewed.
SAR-08 requires a fresh serialized claim and acknowledged UIR handoff.
SAR-04 owns only its topology hunks in app.py; every pre-existing clarification, project-versioning, dashboard, workspace-snapshot and Harbor One hunk remains foreign and unstaged.
SAR-07 must not start until llm_core and llm_runtime_state have one serialized owner.

parallel_frontiers_after_registration.rule: Select only paths with valid claims and no hotfile gate; SAR-04 and SAR-08 remain unavailable while their listed handoffs are unresolved.
